info.name: Mosaic router - chapter 10
info.description:
Mosaic through the Cosmo Router, as chapter 10 of Federated GraphQL on .NET uses it.

Every request here goes to the router and to nothing else. The subgraph collection, postman/mosaic-federation.postman_collection.json, is the other half: it asks each service for what it owns. This one asks the graph.

Start the two subgraphs and the router before running it:

    docker compose up -d mosaic-db
    dotnet run --project src/Mosaic.Catalog
    dotnet run --project src/Mosaic.Api
    docker compose up -d mosaic-router

Nothing here writes, so the collection can be run twice against the same processes.
